<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0d6e5d">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="CareWithJohn">
<meta name="application-name" content="CareWithJohn">
<link rel="manifest" href="./manifest.webmanifest">
<title>CareWithJohn — Care & Support App</title>
<style>
:root{
 --bg:#f4f7f6;--surface:#fff;--ink:#12231e;--muted:#6d7c77;--line:#dce6e2;
 --brand:#0d6e5d;--brand2:#0a5046;--soft:#e8f6f1;--gold:#bd8110;--blue:#5068b8;
 --danger:#b3261e;--shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(11,55,45,.06);--radius:15px
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
body{font-size:15px;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;overscroll-behavior-y:none}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}input,select,textarea{font-size:16px}
.app{min-height:100svh}.sidebar{display:none}.main{min-height:100svh;padding-bottom:90px}
.top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;height:70px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0 13px}
.top-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.logo{height:43px;width:145px;max-width:145px;border-radius:9px;object-fit:contain}.eyebrow{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.85px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:900}.title{font-size:19px;font-weight:950}
.actions{display:flex;gap:6px}.iconbtn,.btn{min-height:42px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;font-weight:850}.btn.primary{background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);color:#fff}.btn.dark{background:var(--brand2);border-color:var(--brand2);color:#fff}.btn.danger{color:var(--danger)}
.searchbar{position:sticky;top:70px;z-index:35;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 10px}.searchbox{position:relative}.searchbox input{width:100%;padding:11px 13px 11px 36px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:#fafcfc;outline:none}.searchicon{position:absolute;left:12px;top:9px;color:var(--muted)}
.view{padding:12px;max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto}.headrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin:5px 0 13px}.headrow h2{margin:0;font-size:23px;letter-spacing:-.2px}.headrow p{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.grid{display:grid;gap:10px}.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.two,.three{grid-template-columns:1fr}.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.kpi .label{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.65px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:900}.kpi .value{font-size:24px;font-weight:950;margin-top:3px}.kpi .sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.sectionlabel{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.1px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:950;margin:16px 3px 7px}.quickgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
.quick{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:13px;padding:13px;text-align:left;box-shadow:var(--shadow);min-height:68px}.quick b{display:block;font-size:13px}.quick span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
.list{display:grid;gap:8px}.item{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;padding:11px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px}.small{font-size:12px}.tiny{font-size:10px}.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:9px;font-weight:950;background:#eef2f0}.good{background:#e4f6ef;color:#0d6e5d}.warn{background:#fff2d6;color:#8a5d00}.bad{background:#ffebea;color:#a41f19}
.hero{border-radius:18px;padding:15px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#ebf8f3);border:1px solid #cbe7dc}.hero-logo{width:min(230px,82%);height:auto;display:block;margin-bottom:7px}.hero h1{font-size:25px;line-height:1.05;margin:0}.hero p{max-width:650px;margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}.hero-actions .btn{flex:1}
.agent{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#123f36,#0d6e5d);color:#fff;border:0}.agent .muted{color:rgba(255,255,255,.76)}.agent textarea{width:100%;min-height:110px;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-top:9px;outline:none}.agentrow{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}.agentrow .btn{flex:1}.agentout{margin-top:10px;padding:11px;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);font-size:12px;min-height:75px}
.progress{height:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.17);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}.progress span{display:block;height:100%;background:#fff}
.schedule-tools{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;overflow:auto;padding-bottom:2px}.seg{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 11px;font-size:11px;font-weight:850;white-space:nowrap}.seg.active{background:var(--soft);color:var(--brand2);border-color:#bfe2d6}
.daybar{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow:auto;margin:9px 0 11px}.day{min-width:74px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:11px;padding:8px;text-align:center}.day b{display:block;font-size:11px}.day span{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)}.day.active{background:var(--brand);color:#fff;border-color:var(--brand)}.day.active span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.76)}
.delivery-tools{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.delivery-date{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;font-weight:800;font-size:12px}.delivery-card{padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;background:#fff}.delivery-card.active{border-color:#bfe2d6;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(13,110,93,.08)}.delivery-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}.delivery-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px;margin-top:9px}.delivery-meta .mini{background:#f7faf8;border-radius:9px;padding:8px}.delivery-meta b{display:block;font-size:12px}.delivery-meta span{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}.delivery-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}.margin-good{color:var(--brand2)}.margin-warn{color:#9a6500}@media(max-width:650px){.delivery-meta{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.delivery-top{display:block}.delivery-top>.badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:7px}.delivery-actions .btn{flex:1;min-width:88px}}
.job{padding:10px;border:1px solid #cfe5dd;border-left:4px solid var(--brand);border-radius:11px;background:#f7fcfa}.job.clean{border-left-color:var(--gold);background:#fffaf0;border-color:#f0dfb9}.job.move{border-left-color:var(--blue);background:#f4f6ff;border-color:#d4d9f1}.job-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}
.calendargrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:6px;min-width:700px}.calendarwrap{overflow:auto}.calday{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;min-height:130px;padding:6px}.calhead{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:5px}.caljob{padding:5px 6px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--soft);border-left:3px solid var(--brand);font-size:9px;margin-top:5px}.caljob.clean{background:#fff7e7;border-left-color:var(--gold)}
.drawer{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:min(91svh,760px);background:#fff;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;z-index:90;transform:translateY(105%);transition:.2s;box-shadow:0 -20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.18);display:flex;flex-direction:column}.drawer.open{transform:translateY(0)}.drawerhead{padding:13px 15px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.drawerbody{padding:14px;overflow:auto;padding-bottom:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(6,20,16,.38);z-index:85;display:none}.overlay.open{display:block}
.formgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:9px}.field label{display:block;font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.45px;margin-bottom:4px}.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid #cbd8d3;border-radius:9px;background:#fff}
.command{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(6,20,16,.38);z-index:100;display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:52px 10px}.command.open{display:flex}.commandcard{width:100%;max-width:720px;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}.commandcard input{width:100%;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px;outline:none}.commandlist{max-height:70svh;overflow:auto;padding:7px}.commanditem{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:11px;border-radius:10px}.commanditem:hover{background:#f2f6f4}
.bottom{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:78px;padding:4px 5px calc(4px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-top:1px solid var(--line);z-index:60;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}.bottom button{border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:11px;color:#677670;font-size:9px;font-weight:900}.bottom button.active{background:var(--soft);color:var(--brand2)}.bottom i{display:block;font-size:18px;line-height:22px;font-style:normal}
.fab{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:96px;width:57px;height:57px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;font-size:26px;box-shadow:0 11px 28px rgba(13,110,93,.3);z-index:58}
.notice{padding:11px 12px;border-radius:11px;font-size:12px;background:#fff6de;border:1px solid #f0dda7;color:#775200}.success{padding:11px 12px;border-radius:11px;font-size:12px;background:#ebf8f3;border:1px solid #c9e7da;color:#14594d}
.footer{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;padding:16px}
@media(min-width:851px){
 body{background:#e9f0ee}.sidebar{display:block}.app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:235px 1fr}.sidebar{display:block;background:#123f36;color:#fff;height:100vh;position:sticky;top:0;padding:14px 10px}.sidebrand{background:#fff;border-radius:11px;padding:6px}.sidebrand img{width:100%;max-height:74px;object-fit:contain}.sidenav{margin-top:14px}.sidenav button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:10px;border-radius:9px;font-weight:800}.sidenav button.active,.sidenav button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}.bottom{display:none}.main{padding-bottom:0}.fab{right:24px;bottom:24px}.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}.two{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.three{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media(max-width:650px){
 .top{height:66px;padding:0 10px}.logo{width:112px;max-width:112px;height:38px}.title{font-size:18px}.eyebrow{font-size:8px}.actions .iconbtn{min-width:42px;padding:8px}.view{padding:11px 10px}.headrow{margin-bottom:11px}.headrow h2{font-size:21px}.agent{border-radius:16px}.agent textarea{min-height:112px}.agentrow{gap:7px}.quickgrid{gap:8px}.quick{padding:11px;min-height:64px}.quick b{font-size:12px}.quick span{font-size:9px}.footer{padding-bottom:8px}.fab{right:14px;bottom:92px;width:54px;height:54px}
}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

/* v16 Work operations layer */
.work-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin:12px 0}.work-stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px}.work-stat .big{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;margin-top:3px}.work-stat.warn{background:#fffaf0;border-color:#efd9a8}.work-stat.good{background:#f4fbf8;border-color:#cbe7dc}.work-stat.danger{background:#fff6f5;border-color:#efc8c4}.work-toolbar{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}.work-filters{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow:auto;padding-bottom:2px}.work-filter{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}.work-filter.active{background:var(--soft);color:var(--brand2);border-color:#bfe2d6}.coverage{height:8px;background:#e8efec;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}.coverage>span{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--brand)}.rota{display:grid;grid-template-columns:210px 1fr;gap:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}.rota-head,.rota-person{padding:11px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);background:#fbfcfc}.rota-head{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}.rota-dayhead{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);background:#f8faf9;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.rota-dayhead>div{padding:10px 7px;border-left:1px solid var(--line);font-size:10px;font-weight:900;text-align:center}.rota-row{display:contents}.rota-person{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.rota-person b{display:block}.rota-person span{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}.rota-days{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);min-height:94px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.rota-cell{padding:5px;border-left:1px solid var(--line);min-width:0}.visit-chip{display:block;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 6px;margin:2px 0;background:var(--soft);border-left:3px solid var(--brand);font-size:9px;line-height:1.2}.visit-chip.clean{background:#fff8e9;border-left-color:var(--gold)}.visit-chip.unassigned{background:#fff6e5;border-left-color:#d99a20}.visit-chip.conflict{background:#fff1ef;border-left-color:#c74a3a}.visit-chip .vtop{font-weight:900}.visit-chip .vmeta{color:#5e6d68;margin-top:2px}.unallocated{display:grid;gap:7px}.unallocated .item{background:#fffaf0;border-color:#efd9a8}.cover-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:11px;margin:6px 0}.smallcaps{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}.work-lower{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.35fr .65fr;gap:12px;margin-top:12px}@media(max-width:900px){.work-summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.work-lower{grid-template-columns:1fr}.rota{grid-template-columns:150px 1fr}.rota-dayhead,.rota-days{min-width:620px}.rota{overflow:auto}.rota-head,.rota-person{position:sticky;left:0;z-index:2}}@media(max-width:650px){.work-summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px}.work-stat{padding:10px}.work-stat .big{font-size:19px}.work-lower{gap:9px}.rota{grid-template-columns:120px 1fr}.rota-dayhead,.rota-days{min-width:560px}.work-toolbar{align-items:stretch}.work-toolbar .btn{width:100%}}

/* v23 planning */
.plan-person,.plan-item{margin-bottom:9px}.plan-person:last-child,.plan-item:last-child{margin-bottom:0}.rulegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px}.rulegrid>div{background:#f7faf9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:11px}.rulegrid b{display:block;font-size:12px}.rulegrid span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4}@media(max-width:800px){.rulegrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}@media(max-width:520px){.rulegrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.plan-item .item{align-items:flex-start}}

.sync-pill{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid #d7e4df;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;background:#fff;color:#48615a}.sync-pill.good{background:#e8f6f1;color:#0d6e5d;border-color:#bfe0d5}.sync-pill.syncing{background:#fff7df;color:#8a6500;border-color:#ead79d}.sync-pill.warn{background:#fff0ee;color:#9b3b30;border-color:#efc5bf}.auth-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(7,31,27,.48);z-index:100;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}.auth-modal.show{display:flex}.auth-card{width:min(430px,100%);background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 25px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}.badtext{color:#a13a30}@media(max-width:700px){.sync-pill{display:none}}

.care-hero{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d6e5d,#0a5046);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:22px;margin-bottom:16px}.care-hero h2{margin:4px 0 5px;font-size:30px}.care-hero p{margin:0;max-width:650px;opacity:.88}.care-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.45fr .85fr;gap:16px}.care-list{display:grid;gap:9px}.person-card{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;border:1px solid #dfe9e5;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:13px;cursor:pointer}.person-card:hover{border-color:#9bc9bc;transform:translateY(-1px)}.person-avatar{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:#e8f6f1;color:#0d6e5d;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;flex:none}.person-avatar.large{width:58px;height:58px}.person-main{min-width:0;flex:1}.person-name{font-weight:900}.person-meta{font-size:12px;color:#6a7772;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.person-tags{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.person-tags span{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;background:#f0f5f3;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 7px;color:#53635e}.arrow{font-size:25px;color:#8b9b95}.handover{border-left:4px solid #0d6e5d}.handover-title{font-weight:900;margin-bottom:7px}.handover-note{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#53635e}.profile-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:15px}.care-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #e4ebe8;padding-bottom:8px;overflow:auto}.care-tabs span{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}.care-tabs .active{background:#e8f6f1;color:#0d6e5d}.profile-section{margin-top:15px}.profile-section .sectionlabel{margin-bottom:7px}@media(max-width:760px){.care-hero{padding:17px;align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.care-hero h2{font-size:25px}.care-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.care-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}

/* v26 care app visual redesign — calmer, lighter, person-centred */
:root{--brand:#157a68;--brand2:#0d5d50;--soft:#eaf7f3;--bg:#f6f8f7;--line:#e2e9e6;--muted:#6d7b76}
body{background:#f6f8f7;color:#17322d}
.sidebar{background:#fff!important;border-right:1px solid #e4ebe8!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.sidebrand{padding:20px 18px 14px!important}.sidebrand img{max-width:170px!important}
.sidenav button{border-radius:12px!important;color:#51615c!important;margin:2px 10px!important}.sidenav button.active{background:#eaf7f3!important;color:#0d5d50!important}
.main{background:#f6f8f7!important}.top{background:rgba(255,255,255,.94)!important;border-bottom:1px solid #e5ebe8!important;box-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(17,55,48,.03)!important}.top .eyebrow{color:#6b7c76!important}.top .title{color:#17322d!important}.logo{width:38px!important;height:38px!important}
.searchbar{background:#f6f8f7!important}.searchbar .searchbox{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #e3ebe7!important;box-shadow:none!important;border-radius:14px!important}
.view{max-width:1180px!important;padding-top:20px!important}.footer{color:#8a9893!important}
.btn.primary{background:#157a68!important;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(21,122,104,.12)!important}.btn{border-radius:11px!important}.card{border:1px solid #e2e9e6!important;box-shadow:0 3px 16px rgba(20,54,47,.035)!important;border-radius:16px!important}
.sectionlabel{color:#71807a!important}
.bottom{background:rgba(255,255,255,.97)!important;border-top:1px solid #e3eae7!important;box-shadow:0 -6px 22px rgba(17,55,48,.05)!important}.bottom button{color:#73817c!important}.bottom button.active,.bottom button:focus{color:#157a68!important}
.care-modern-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px;margin:2px 0 15px}.care-greeting{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#157a68;letter-spacing:.01em}.care-modern-head h2{font-size:30px;line-height:1.12;margin:4px 0 3px;color:#17322d;letter-spacing:-.03em}.care-modern-head p{margin:0;color:#7a8883;font-size:13px}.care-head-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.care-icon-action{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #dfe8e4;background:#fff;color:#53645e;font-weight:900}.care-add{border:0;background:#17322d;color:#fff;border-radius:11px;padding:11px 14px;font-weight:800}
.care-statusbar{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 2px 16px;color:#7a8883;font-size:12px}.care-statusbar b{color:#314842}.status-dot{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#42aa86;margin-right:6px}.status-alert{color:#a45c20!important}.status-alert b{color:#a45c20}
.next-visit-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eef9f6 0%,#fff 72%);border:1px solid #cfe8df;border-radius:20px;padding:18px 19px;margin-bottom:13px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(21,122,104,.06)}.next-visit-card.empty{padding:22px}.next-kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:900;color:#6d817a;margin-bottom:10px}.next-main{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px}.next-avatar{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:17px;background:#157a68;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:15px;flex:none}.next-person{min-width:0;flex:1}.next-time{font-size:12px;color:#157a68;font-weight:900}.next-time span{font-weight:700;color:#778781}.next-person h3{font-size:20px;margin:3px 0 3px;letter-spacing:-.02em}.next-person p{margin:0;color:#697974;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.next-arrow{width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid #dce9e4;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:#157a68;font-size:26px}.next-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:15px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #dbe9e4;color:#65756f;font-size:12px}.next-foot .btn{padding:9px 12px}
.care-quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:22px}.care-quick button{border:1px solid #e0e8e5;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 10px;color:#445650;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;text-align:left;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.care-quick button span{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:9px;background:#edf7f4;color:#157a68;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px}
.care-modern-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:18px;margin-bottom:22px}.care-section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:9px}.care-section-head h3{margin:0;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.01em}.care-section-head p{margin:3px 0 0;color:#82908b;font-size:11px}.text-link{border:0;background:none;color:#157a68;font-weight:900;font-size:11px;padding:4px 0}.people-modern{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e9e6;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden}.person-modern{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:12px 13px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #edf1ef;background:#fff;text-align:left}.person-modern:last-child{border-bottom:0}.person-modern:hover{background:#fbfdfc}.modern-avatar{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:11px;flex:none}.modern-avatar.a0{background:#e8f5f1;color:#157a68}.modern-avatar.a1{background:#eef0fb;color:#5c64a8}.modern-avatar.a2{background:#fff2e6;color:#a76427}.modern-avatar.a3{background:#f6ebf5;color:#8b5683}.modern-avatar.a4{background:#edf4ed;color:#4f7656}.modern-person-main{min-width:0;flex:1}.modern-person-main b{display:block;font-size:13px}.modern-person-main span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#82908b;margin-top:3px}.modern-person-status{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;padding:5px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:#f1f4f2;color:#72817b}.modern-person-status.today{background:#eaf7f3;color:#157a68}.modern-person-status.done{background:#eef8f1;color:#4c8060}.modern-chevron{font-size:19px;color:#9aa8a3}
.handover-modern{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e9e6;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;display:flex;gap:12px;min-height:120px}.handover-mark{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;background:#eaf7f3;color:#157a68;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;flex:none}.handover-modern b{font-size:13px}.handover-modern p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#64746e;margin:6px 0}.handover-modern span{font-size:10px;color:#9aa7a2}.today-care-section{margin-top:2px}.today-care-list{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e9e6;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden}.today-care-row{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #edf1ef;background:#fff;padding:12px 13px;text-align:left}.today-care-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}.today-time{width:44px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#4d615a}.today-line{width:5px;height:34px;border-radius:5px;background:#bfe2d6;flex:none}.today-info{min-width:0;flex:1}.today-info b{display:block;font-size:12px}.today-info span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#82908b;margin-top:3px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.today-state{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 7px;background:#f1f4f2;color:#72817b;white-space:nowrap}.today-state.done{background:#eef8f1;color:#4c8060}.today-state.needs{background:#fff1eb;color:#a85a32}.care-alert-strip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:13px;padding:11px 13px;border:1px solid #f0dfc9;background:#fff9f1;border-radius:13px;font-size:11px;color:#765c43}.care-alert-strip b{color:#86582c}.care-alert-strip span{flex:1}.care-alert-strip button{border:0;background:none;color:#9a5d27;font-weight:900}.soft-empty{padding:18px;color:#87948f;font-size:12px;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:850px){.care-modern-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.care-quick{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.view{padding:14px 12px 86px!important}.care-modern-head{align-items:flex-start}.care-modern-head h2{font-size:25px}.care-add{padding:9px 11px}.care-icon-action{width:36px;height:36px}.care-statusbar{gap:11px;font-size:11px;padding-bottom:13px}.next-visit-card{border-radius:17px;padding:15px}.next-avatar{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px}.next-person h3{font-size:17px}.next-person p{font-size:11px}.care-quick{gap:7px;margin-bottom:19px}.care-quick button{padding:10px 9px;font-size:11px}.care-modern-grid{gap:17px}.care-section-head h3{font-size:15px}.today-care-row{padding:11px 10px}.today-time{width:39px;font-size:10px}.today-state{display:none}}

<style id="cwj-v27-app-shell">
/* v27 — native-app visual system */
:root{--app-bg:#eef3f1;--app-surface:#fff;--app-border:#e3ebe7;--app-green:#0d6e5d;--app-green-dark:#084d43;--app-soft:#e9f6f2}
html,body{background:var(--app-bg)!important}
body{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif!important}
.app{max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;min-height:100svh;background:#f7f9f8;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(13,110,93,.04)}
.main{background:#f7f9f8!important}
.top{height:76px!important;padding:0 22px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96)!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--app-border)!important;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.02)!important}
.top-left{gap:11px!important}.top .logo{width:42px!important;height:42px!important;border-radius:13px!important;object-fit:contain!important}.title{font-size:17px!important;font-weight:850!important}.eyebrow{font-size:9px!important;font-weight:750!important;letter-spacing:.05em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:#82908b!important}
.actions .iconbtn{width:42px!important;height:42px!important;border-radius:14px!important;background:#f7faf9!important;border:1px solid var(--app-border)!important}
.searchbar{top:76px!important;background:rgba(247,249,248,.96)!important;border:0!important;padding:12px 22px 8px!important}.searchbox input{height:44px!important;border-radius:14px!important;background:#fff!important;border-color:var(--app-border)!important;font-size:14px!important;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(20,50,43,.03)!important}
.view{max-width:1080px!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:18px 22px 30px!important}
.footer{max-width:1080px!important;margin:auto!important;color:#9aa7a2!important}
.sidebar{width:238px!important;background:#fff!important;border-right:1px solid var(--app-border)!important;padding:18px 12px!important;box-shadow:none!important}.sidebrand{border:0!important;background:#f5f9f7!important;border-radius:17px!important;padding:10px!important}.sidebrand img{max-height:64px!important}.sidenav{margin-top:18px!important}.sidenav button{padding:12px 13px!important;border-radius:13px!important;color:#53635e!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:750!important}.sidenav button.active{background:var(--app-soft)!important;color:var(--app-green-dark)!important}.sidenav button:hover{background:#f5f8f7!important}
/* turn the desktop workspace into an app canvas */
@media(min-width:901px){.app{grid-template-columns:238px minmax(0,1fr)!important}.main{min-width:0}.view{min-height:calc(100svh - 110px)}.hero,.card,.agent,.next-visit-card,.people-modern,.today-care-list,.handover-modern{box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(23,55,48,.035)!important}.hero{border-radius:22px!important}.card{border-radius:18px!important}.fab{width:56px!important;height:56px!important;border-radius:18px!important}}
/* native mobile app proportions */
@media(max-width:900px){
 body{background:#f7f9f8!important}.app{min-height:100svh!important}.sidebar{display:none!important}.main{padding-bottom:82px!important}.top{height:68px!important;padding:0 14px!important}.top .logo{width:40px!important;height:40px!important}.searchbar{top:68px!important;padding:8px 12px 7px!important}.searchbox input{height:42px!important}.view{padding:14px 12px 92px!important}.bottom{height:76px!important;padding:5px 7px calc(5px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;border-top:1px solid var(--app-border)!important;box-shadow:0 -8px 24px rgba(20,50,43,.06)!important}.bottom button{font-size:10px!important;border-radius:13px!important;min-height:52px!important}.bottom i{font-size:19px!important;margin-bottom:2px!important}.fab{right:14px!important;bottom:90px!important;width:52px!important;height:52px!important;border-radius:17px!important;font-size:23px!important}.hero{border-radius:20px!important;padding:17px!important}.hero h1{font-size:24px!important}.hero-actions{gap:8px!important}.hero-actions .btn{min-height:44px!important;border-radius:13px!important}.card{border-radius:17px!important}.sectionlabel{font-size:10px!important;letter-spacing:.1em!important}
}
/* tactile controls */
button,.btn,.quick,.person-card,.person-modern,.today-care-row,.visit-chip{touch-action:manipulation}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(13,110,93,.22)!important;outline-offset:2px!important}
</style>


<style id="cwj-final-polish">
:root{--app-radius:22px}
.top{backdrop-filter:saturate(1.05) blur(12px)}
.sidebar{background:#fff}
.sidenav button{min-height:44px;border-radius:13px}
.bottom button{min-height:52px}
.card,.hero,.quick,.person,.metric{transition:transform .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease,border-color .16s ease}
@media (hover:hover){.card:hover,.quick:hover,.person:hover,.metric:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(11,55,45,.08)}}
.drawer{border-top-left-radius:24px;border-top-right-radius:24px}
@media(min-width:900px){.drawer{border-radius:22px 0 0 22px}.view{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto}.searchbar{max-width:1160px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}}
</style>
</head>
